# Implementing Domain-Driven Design for Gemini CLI

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/ddd-implementing/ in the guided-plugins repository.

Install from a checkout of the repository (Gemini installs one extension per repository from GitHub, so use the local path):

```bash
gemini extensions install ./dist/gemini/ddd-implementing
```

- 36 skills (including 6 mode skills), each also a slash command `/ddd-implementing:ddd-implementing-<name>`.
- 21 subagents, started with `@ddd-implementing-<name> <task>`.
